headline: Research findings flow into a writer pass and a citation-checker pass — risk is the writer trusting unverified retrieval.
name: Research → Write → Cite

conditions: retrieved content is rendered into prompt without sanitization
mitigations: wrap retrieved content in clearly-delimited untrusted block
have critic pass verify citations point to retrieved sources
A_prompt_injection.rationale: Retrieved web content is treated as trusted context by the writer, allowing prompt injection from arbitrary search results to leak into the final draft.

mitigations: redact sensitive terms from search queries
B_data_leakage.rationale: Search queries may carry user context to the retriever's vendor, but no privileged secrets are typically in scope.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: The writer and critic share an identical capability surface (claude-code), but their roles are sequential, not concurrent.

conditions: citation pass uses same source set as writer
mitigations: have critic pass query an independent retrieval source
D_cascading_error.rationale: Errors in retrieval propagate into the draft and may not be caught if the citation-checker pass relies on the same retrieval set.

E_compliance.rationale: No regulated data classes are typically processed in research-and-write workflows.
